tool_input.summary: Set a relative IF formula in D1 and copy it with its style to D5 and D9 so each Result cell returns Single A, Single B, or Multiple based on B and the cell below.

operations.formula: =IF(AND(B1="Description A",B2=""),"Single A",IF(AND(B1="Description B",B2=""),"Single B",IF(OR(AND(B1="Description A",B2="Description B"),AND(B1="Description B",B2="Description A")),"Multiple","")))
